# Pella — chamber-maid (the clever one)

*The strongest maid-candidate (OQ-CL2) for the Book II co-conspirator role. Quick, bright, ambitious.*

## Description

The sharp one: quick, bright, observant, ambitious, and well-liked below-stairs. A poor girl with more wit
than her station has any use for. Everything that makes her a slight risk in Book I (she pays attention; she
reaches the world; she wants more) is exactly the engine of the Book II maid: the face, the hands, the legs
of an operation a caged princess runs through one trusted pair of eyes.

## Voice

Quick, bright, town-clever smallfolk Common Tongue; reads a room fast; asks good questions and knows when
not to; a little forward for a maid, charming enough to be forgiven it.

## Hard Fences
1. **Smallfolk, setting seen from below.** Reads a *secret*, never the true *system*.
2. **Candidate, not committed.** Do not write her as the confirmed co-protagonist until OQ-CL2 is ruled.
3. **Pre-romantic warmth is latent, never explicit** in Book I.
